text_block_list.text:
Today is finally Yamanin Zephyr's
debut race...!
choice_data_list: Your body isn't stiffening up or anything, is it?

text_block_list.text:
I couldn't help but ask.
Official races are a completely different ballgame from the mock races held at the Academy.
She will be exposed to the public eye as everyone gauges the worth of this new star, surrounded by serious runners radiating the drive to begin their legends here, but—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
No, it feels just like usual—
very Japanese and relaxing.
choice_data_list: O-Oh, I see! Then that's good!

text_block_list.text:
It seems she isn't nervous at all.
...That's the best outcome.

I always knew she moved at her own pace, but...
she might just naturally be oblivious to what everyone else is doing.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
What I must accomplish upon the turf is already decided.
I shall simply become the wind.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Being able to focus solely on that
is an absolute blessing. ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Please watch, Trainer.
I shall show you the first storm of my spring—!
